title: Grateful Dead Live at Paramount Northwest Theater on 1972-07-22
lineage: Master Reels @ full track mono>Tandberg Model 11>Wavelab 96/24 1ch mono>wav 44.1/16 2ch mono>flac
source: Tandberg Model 11 R2R deck, Sony ECM-22P mic > Master Reel

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording that improves after the first song, highlighted by a memorable Heart & Soul story segment but marred by obvious gaps between tracks.
ai_review.review: The tape is an audience source that sounds decent on typical speakers and gets noticeably better after the opening number. Reviewers love the rapid‑fire Yellow Dog story woven into the Heart & Soul vamp, though they point out clear stop‑and‑start transitions between Truckin', He's Gone and Sugar Magnolia, which detracts from the flow.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed review gives a moderate 3‑star rating; the show has a standout storytelling moment but suffers from recording glitches and lack of seamless song transitions.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Initial song is faint, then improves; however, there are audible stops with no transitions between Truckin' → He's Gone and He's Gone → Sugar Magnolia. No mention of SBD leftovers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Clear gaps and stops between several songs, breaking the natural flow of the set.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby Weir delivers a rapid‑fire Yellow Dog story during the Heart & Soul vamp.
